title: Q 11:9-13. The Certainty of the Answer to Prayer
summary: The Documenta Q volumes give a presentation and evaluation of the history of research on each section of the Sayings Gospel Q. This volume treats the segment Q 11:9-13 together with Luke 11:5-8 which follow on the Lord's Prayer and constitute the first commentary on this central text. All differences between Matthew and Luke in this section are discussed and suggestions for the reconstruction of the text of Q made, among others such important one's as „egg/scorpion“ against „bread/stone“ (Q 11:11-12) or „Holy Spirit“ against „good things“ (Q 11:13).
